cases.trigger: Create a system-aware dashboard with reusable components, real content, responsive layout, and rendered proof.

expected.context: one active packet plus only decision-changing context
outcomeInvariants: The dashboard preserves coherent layout, component, type, color/depth, and system-reuse relations under representative content.
Each material design concern reaches an evidence-backed state without requiring a predeclared Skill route.
The resulting artifact remains editable through native reusable structure rather than one giant mutation.

cases.trigger: Rename one known layer on one resolved page.

outcomeInvariants: The resolved layer is renamed without creating unrelated planning artifacts.
The edit preserves target identity and returns bounded evidence for the changed layer.

cases.trigger: A task appears relevant to eight Figma Skills but only the component API is currently unresolved.

expected.context: keep the active component question; load only context that can change it, then shed it
outcomeInvariants: The active component-API question remains explicit while unrelated context is not preloaded.
The result records the decision mechanism and releases branch detail once the decision is durable.

failureSignals: reads all eight Skills before acting
summarizes prose instead of decision mechanism

cases.trigger: Explain an inspect-create-verify-recover workflow with two failure branches.

expected.context: short node labels plus branch conditions
outcomeInvariants: The two failure branches are perceptible as branches rather than buried in narrative prose.
The representation preserves inspect-create-verify-recover ordering and recovery conditions.

cases.trigger: Show completion and failure rates across four execution lanes.

expected.context: values, units, labels, and evidence caveat
outcomeInvariants: Completion and failure rates remain quantitatively comparable across all four lanes.
Values, units, evidence caveats, and unequal state salience remain visible.

failureSignals: all states use equal visual salience

cases.trigger: Bind text and fill styles under a dynamic-page manifest.

expected.context: runtimeSdk v2 async page, style, and variable helpers
outcomeInvariants: Async page/style/variable mechanics are used correctly under the dynamic-page manifest.
A failing native operation is diagnosed rather than blindly retried.

cases.trigger: A dispatched Figma mutation times out before the caller receives a result.

expected.context: inspect queue and target before any retry
outcomeInvariants: Ambiguous timeout state is inspected before any retry can duplicate a mutation.
Recovery preserves queue/target truth and does not restart unrelated work.

cases.trigger: Reuse a component from a published library in another Figma file.

expected.context: registry/source/consumer evidence needed for the reuse claim; Skill selection is observed after execution
outcomeInvariants: Reuse is proven by source/consumer identity and native linkage rather than visual similarity.
Detached copies or LOCAL_VERIFIED evidence are not promoted to cross-file reuse proof.

cases.trigger: Complete a five-clause Figma request whose visual, system, interaction, export, and verification obligations all remain required.

expected.context: every source clause has an obligation id and terminal evidence state; Skill selection is not injected
outcomeInvariants: Every required source clause remains traceable to an obligation and terminal evidence state.
Overall PASS is impossible while a required obligation is unresolved or evidence-free.

failureSignals: a required clause disappears from output
overall PASS with an unresolved obligation

cases.trigger: Attempt a raw or typed Figma mutation without traceId, operation intent, or postconditions.

expected.context: MCP rejects before dispatch and returns structured INVALID_PARAMS
outcomeInvariants: A mutation lacking required trace/operation/postcondition context is rejected before dispatch.
The server does not infer missing intent from JavaScript or upgrade declarations into evidence.

failureSignals: missing postconditions are treated as verified

cases.trigger: Build a tokenized reusable dashboard metric grid, then move one card, span another across two columns, and verify the layout still preserves comparison structure under a narrower container.

expected.context: semantic component/token decisions plus bounded grid owner/child evidence; edits preserve existing identities
outcomeInvariants: The metric grid preserves reusable component/token semantics and comparison structure under the narrower container.
Move/span edits operate on existing identities without detaching or rebuilding the grid subtree.
Verification uses bounded grid owner/child evidence rather than a full-document dump.

failureSignals: uses manual x/y coordinates for repeated comparison cards
rebuilds or detaches the grid to perform the edit
loads the full document tree instead of the grid owner and representative consumers
reports layout PASS without row/column/span/pressure evidence
